name: std::ranges::zip_transform_view<F,Views...>::begin

declarations.code:
constexpr auto begin() const

    requires ranges::range<const ranges::zip_view<Views...>>;

intro:
Obtains the beginning iterator of zip_transform_view.

1) Equivalent to return /*iterator*/<false>(*this, zip_.begin());.

2) Equivalent to return /*iterator*/<true>(*this, zip_.begin());.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: ranges::range<const ranges::zip_view<Views...>> is modeled if and only if for every type Vi in Views..., const Vi models range.
